issues.issue: Pin engagement, spring fit and travel-stop setting need kit fit verification.
issues.source: HK-FCC lists R-FHS and AN3-4A travel limit; plan30.
issues.check: Check all detents, spring return and supplied stop before use.

issues.issue: Full Companion pulley route and washer allocation remain unresolved.
issues.source: Plan30 shows splitter relationship; legacy full routing is not a complete Companion installation map.
issues.check: Trace cable through current kit pulleys and guards; confirm all stacks. Do not fabricate cable lengths from scene.

issues.issue: Aft-most flap pulley inspection and service-life tracking are absent from the earlier guide.
issues.source: Factory AD-004, 12/11/25: MS20220-1 (AN202A-1); inspection annual / 250 h; replacement 500 h or as needed.
issues.check: Identify the aft-most pulley on the actual Companion, check condition, preserve access, and record installed hours/inspection and replacement due points per AD-004. Full cable routing remains an open item.

issues.issue: First flap-speed setting conflicts between newsletter and current factory alert; in-flight deflections are not ground rigging targets.
issues.source: 2022 Q4 p9 and 2023 Q1 p9: 100 mph at 10 degrees; current factory OA-002: 95 mph at 10 degrees. Both associate limits with in-flight air-loaded deflection.
issues.check: Obtain current applicable Companion limits from the designer/factory before placarding. Do not tighten/preload cables to force ground angles to the in-flight values. See FINAL003 for the remaining rigging requirements.

before_build: Factory AD-004 identifies the aft-most flap-system pulley for recurring inspection and replacement. Keep access to this pulley when fitting the baggage floor; use the factory illustration to identify it on your kit.
